card.name: Ending 'li/lu' in Turkish names and brands
card.fires_on: The piece 'li' or 'lu' that ends or sits inside a proper name, mainly Turkish place and person names (Tabanli, Göbekli, Hatipoğlu). It also fires inside brand names like BARACLUDE and NORLIQVA.
